phase: Before reading author source or controls; parent brief already supplied headline formulas and reported test counts.
reviewer_context: Fresh independent restricted-input context; requested Astra/max; same-family, no claim of cross-family diversity.
independent_criteria: Wilson action and temporal slab: independently integrate the intermediate gauge transformations and match every plaquette factor and half spatial factor; reject if the operator represents uncoupled links or a different measure.

Transfer positivity and sectors: derive SU(2) character coefficients independently from Haar orthogonality; distinguish pointwise positive kernel, positive definite operator, injectivity, and uniqueness. Check beta=0, beta<0 exclusion, trivial versus nontrivial spatial cycle domains. Show the full invariant Hilbert space is used and contains a nonzero centered state.

Gap estimate: derive the Doob-transform minorization using an explicit probability measure and operator eigenfunction equation, not the asserted bound. Test finite-dimensional quadrature for the actual one-plaquette gauge-invariant SU(2) Wilson transfer operator with spatial interaction. Mutate omitted spatial weights and wrong temporal powers. Track beta, edge count, temporal spacing and finite-volume/continuum quantifiers.

Soft filter: integrate normalized SU(2) Haar directly in quaternion coordinates; test nonunit, noncentral and zero path means, normalized versus unnormalized traces, and lambda sign/factor. Use sphere moments and quadrature distinct from author implementation.

Coarse covariance: derive conditional independence for distinct coarse edges before integrating a correlated fine law. Expand the product to degree eight; test a correlated concrete fine Wilson setup or exact finite-law integral, and an overlapping-edge negative control. Verify the fine probability law is independent of lambda or account for induced dependence.

Source transport: evaluate derivatives of log partition functions before and after integrating coarse fields; include the normalization denominator. At lambda=0 require source-only covariance persistence. Test dropping the source-only logarithm and assuming reverse reconstruction; inspect whether singular limits actually belong to the finite Wilson family.

Scope: no general no-go for all renormalization mechanisms; no promotion of finite-volume gap, numerical quadrature or auxiliary kernel spectrum to MG0-MG5. Read each actual load-bearing dependency at an explicit hash and do not treat prior reviews or status labels as premises.
failure_policy: Retain failures and raw outputs; distinguish operational/numerical issues from proof defects; send narrow evidenced findings to parent; author changes require affected same-session confirmation.
